messages:
emily (producer): Uploaded cut + transcript for Kalypso case study: https://files.redwood/kalypso-cut1.mp4 + kalypso-transcript.txt. Proposed embargo 2025-07-08 07:00 PT. Need legal on hero quote and sign-off for using a perf chart excerpt.

marta (prod-marketing): Lovely. Can we aim for a 10-word hero? Also will plan a short 20-30s social clip + long blog.

emily (producer): Hero option 1: "Redwood helped Kalypso cut inference spend ~3x and stabilize latency." Hero option 2: "Cut inference spend ~3x and get predictable tail latency with Redwood."

ben (legal): Quick flags: switch any exact multipliers to approximate (~3x) unless finance signs off. Avoid words like "cut" when we don't own the metric lineage; suggest "reduced" or "helped reduce". Also need signed release for the chart image.

ryan (sales-ops): Routing: when live, route Kalypso leads to SDR-Kalypso queue and add tag source=case-kalypso. Sample webhook: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-kalypso","queue":"SDR-Kalypso"}'```

nina (growth): Recommend a follow-up webinar: "How Kalypso migrated to Dedicated" — 45 min, two weeks after embargo (2025-07-22 10:00 PT). Will use webinar to surface benchmarks and migration checklist.

marta (prod-marketing): Confirm speakers: Kalypso infra lead, Kalypso CTO (optional), Redwood Solutions Eng. Emily, can you draft the 1-pager and request release signature from Kalypso for the chart?

emily (producer): On it. I emailed the Kalypso comms lead for the chart release and uploaded a redacted perf CSV to the drive.

publish-bot: upload complete: kalypso-cut1.mp4 (126MB)

ben (legal): Once I have the signed release and the appendix with raw logs, I'll approve the hero phrasing: "Redwood helped Kalypso reduce inference spend ~3x while making tail latency more predictable." I'll send formal sign-off email then.

ryan (sales-ops): I'll prepare the routing automation and plan a smoke test on 2025-07-06. Tagging rule: if lead.utm_campaign=="kalypso-case" then campaign=kalypso-q3-2025.

nina (growth): I'll build landing + UTMs and draft social snippets. Can we A/B test hero option 1 vs 2?

marta (prod-marketing): Yes please A/B test. Timeline recap: legal & release sign-off by 2025-07-02, final edit by 2025-07-03, landing + routing ready 2025-07-06, embargo 2025-07-08 07:00 PT, webinar 2025-07-22 10:00 PT.

emily (producer): Closing: will update thread when release signed and final asset uploaded. Please keep embargo internal until 7/08.

ben (legal): Approval pending attachments; will send email after those arrive.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks team. End of thread.
